attribution_note: m(53) = 14 and m(59) = 15 are NOT repeated in this file. This repository holds its own solver-certified, hash-bound provenance for both (provenance/m53-exact-2026-07-25/, provenance/m59-exact-2026-07-27/, note.tex Sec. 'Exact values of m(p)'). Per the source repository's own README (2026-08-23 fetch): 'The values m(53) = 14 and m(59) = 15 are his [Scheinerman's]; ... m(53) and m(59) were proved minimal independently here and by Watson in the same month.' m(61), m(67), m(71), m(73) were computed first by Kwaczynski and appear ONLY there; they are cited here as external rows.
tier_correction_note: The source repository's own tier table (README.md, 'Values' section, fetched 2026-08-23) marks p = 53 as 'solver-certified, hash-bound' but p = 59, 61, 67, 71, 73 all as 'search only': two independent search programs agree and the witness is checked, but no proof object is retained. The four rows below are therefore labeled EXTERNAL / search-only, not solver-certified, hash-bound; that stronger tier applies only to his p = 53 row, which this file does not cite.
